final_message:
The bug was in `BillingEngine.refund` in `billing/engine.py`. It called `refunds.refund_invoice(invoice_id, self.ctx, reason)`, but that function expects `(ctx, invoice_id, reason)`. The swapped arguments caused the `'str' object has no attribute 'store'` error. I swapped them back, and all 25 tests now pass, including the new one.

I also wrote `answer.json` with `{"file": "engine.py", "function": "refund"}`.

I added your reproduction as `tests/test_reports.py`. It has a few stray blank lines after the import, which I didn't clean up.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat reports.py && grep -n "def refund" -A40 *.py | head -80

cd .. && sed -i 's/refunds.refund_invoice(invoice_id, self.ctx, reason)/refunds.refund_invoice(self.ctx, invoice_id, reason)/' billing/engine.py && echo '{"file": "engine.py", "function": "refund"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

cd /tmp/bsvc-l44t0ge7/billing-service && ls tests | head -30 && cat >> tests/test_reports.py <<'EOF'


def test_revenue_between_nets_credit_notes(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    world.engine.refund(inv["id"])
    assert reports.revenue_between(world.ctx, inv["paid_at"], inv["paid_at"] + 1) == {"usd": 0}
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -8

sed -i '' '1i\
from billing import reports\
\

' tests/test_reports.py && head -5 tests/test_reports.py && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -4
